stories.kicker: The Atelier · Hand Planes And Chisels
stories.headline: Quangsheng publishes the same sole-flatness tolerance as Lie-Nielsen at half the price
stories.dek: Workshop Heaven lists the Quangsheng No. 4 at £170 against Lie-Nielsen’s US$375, both ground to one and a half thousandths of an inch — and the British shop is barred by contract from selling the Chinese plane into North America.

stories.headline: Lange published twenty numbers about its new Datograph Perpetual, and not the price
stories.dek: The 410.136 E carries 556 movement parts, 45 jewels, 11 baguette diamonds and a moon phase good for 122.6 years; the price is on request in every market Lange sells in, and its mass is published nowhere at all.

stories.headline: Indonesia borrowed 240 trillion rupiah to build eighty thousand Red-and-White cooperatives
stories.dek: Four state banks lent it to one company, PT Agrinas Pangan Nusantara; 58.03 per cent of the 2026 Village Fund now services the debt, and the programme’s own live dashboard recorded 56.68 billion rupiah of sales for the year.

stories.headline: Vučić concedes Serbia’s election to a student list with no leader
stories.dek: The Student List is fronted by Ilija Srdanović, a Novi Sad cardiologist, and its candidates were chosen by student plenums; CeSID–Ipsos puts it on 138 of 250 seats, and the Republic Electoral Commission has published nothing at all.

stories.headline: Indonesia cut piped gas to Singapore hours after NEA served ten haze notices
stories.dek: Jakarta’s SKK Migas put the reduction at 31 BBTUD from 24 October; Singapore’s Energy Market Authority counts 17 over eighteen days, and neither government has reconciled the two figures.

stories.headline: The US Treasury deleted its compute threshold and renamed the technology “super intelligence”
stories.dek: The Outbound Investment Security Program rule published on Monday at 91 FR 67396 defines an SI system in the words of the 2020 artificial-intelligence statute, plus two phrases — and keeps hard numbers for supercomputers and memory.

stories.headline: Meta put the Adventurer on sale in Singapore at S$419 and published no specifications
stories.dek: The Singapore page lists nine frame configurations with no weight, no battery life and no camera resolution — and the 53.8-gram figure every review quotes originates in a corporate IT reseller’s product listing.

stories.headline: Wildwood scored 100 per cent from 117 critics and opened third behind Clayface
stories.dek: LAIKA’s stop-motion feature took about eleven million dollars on 2,942 screens against Clayface’s twenty-four million; its Metacritic score is 87 from 36 reviews, and inside that set sits a 50.

stories.headline: A study of 1,977 Chinese seventh-graders found parental support outweighed early puberty
stories.dek: Published on 22 October in the Journal of Adolescent Health, the cohort’s mean age is 12.73 with a standard deviation of 0.38 — and the coefficient for what parents did was larger than the one for when puberty arrived.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · Oil And Breakevens
stories.headline: Brent gained six per cent; America’s ten-year inflation breakeven fell one basis point
stories.dek: Brent settled at US$116.72 on Friday 23 October, more than twenty per cent above where it started the month, while the breakeven implied by the Treasury’s own nominal and real curves went from 2.35 per cent to 2.34.

stories.headline: The Pegbox carries 678,700 posts and bans every for-sale listing
stories.dek: Maestronet, the entire English-speaking town square of lutherie, carries 988,600 posts across all its boards and bans for-sale listings on both the making board and the auction board — which is why an amateur-made instrument has no price.

stories.headline: A six-week creatine trial found no Stroop effect and led on a WHOOP score
stories.dek: Fifty-one perimenopausal women averaging 46 years trained twice a week and took creatine or placebo; Stroop times improved in every arm and the groups did not differ, and the positive finding is a WHOOP sleep-consistency score.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Before The Year Turns
stories.headline: Kenshi Yonezu added a second Singapore night for his first world tour
stories.dek: The GHOST tour plays the Indoor Stadium on 29 and 30 January; Diana Krall takes two Esplanade nights at S$88 to S$268 in November, and the January sumo basho opens its advance sale on 5 December.
